Detailed Description:
The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry, provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to the Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. The applicant should be a Native/Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for not less than 5 years.
1. For Other Economically Backward Classes, the Income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹ 75,000/-.
1. The Parent/Guardian of the applicant should not be living within a radius of 5 km from the hostel.

- Conveyance Charges for 6 Times (3 Down and 3 Up) in a Year.

National Jute Board Act, 2008 provides to “secure better working conditions and provisions and improve amenities and incentives for workers engaged in the jute industry.”

Detailed Description:
The National Jute Board Act, 2008, provides to “secure better working conditions and provisions and improvement of amenities and incentives for workers engaged in the jute industry” under Section, 5(2)(xxii) for the welfare of workers in jute-producing units. In line with the same, NJB is going to extend support to the workers’ families to motivate them towards educating their girl children, a scholarship scheme as a Workers’ Welfare measure. 
**Objectives of the Scheme:** 
The objectives of the Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Jute Mills / MSMEs Workers are:

- To provide financial incentive to the girl children of the workers of the Jute Mills/MSMEs, upon passing the Secondary and Higher Secondary examinations to encourage them to acquire the minimum required education for making them employable . 
- To encourage workers to work in the jute industry and to remain there for longer period, hence help reduce workers’ attrition rate, which is big problem of the Industry .
- To help Jute Mills/MSME units to face lesser labour problems .
- The enhance Millers-Workers relationship. 
- To make the workers feel socially protected through such welfare measures for their children .
- To support women empowerment through Girl Children education.

Eligibility:
- Scholarship to the girl children on Passing out the Examination in 2021(2021-22), 2022 (2022-23), 2023 (2023-24), 2024 (2024-25), 2025 (2025-26) - Total 5 Years (2021-26) 15th Finance Commission period.
- The scheme will be applicable to the girl children of the workers of Jute Mills and MSME - JDP units engaged in the production of jute products.

Benefits:
- Secondary Education (for Girls only ): ₹ 5,000/- (Five thousand)
- Higher Secondary Education (for Girls only): ₹ 10,000/- (Ten thousand)

Brief Description:
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana”, implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.
***Objectives:***

 - To reduce the financial risk for farmers during periods of low market prices for vegetables and fruits by ensuring a protected price.
 - To encourage diversification in agriculture by supporting horticultural farmers.

***Crops covered under the scheme:***

 - 21 Crops: Ladyfinger, Chilli, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Cabbage, Radish, Tomato, Onion, Potato, Cauliflower, Carrot, Peas, Capsicum, Brinjal, Turmeric, Garlic, Mango, Kinnow, Guava, Litchi, Plum

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a landowner, lessee, or tenant farmer in Haryana.
 1. The farmer should cultivate one of the 21 listed crops.

**Note 1:** Registration on the [Meri Fasal, Mera Byora portal](https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period is mandatory.
**Note 2:** The land and crop details must be certified by the Horticulture Department.

Benefits:
1. To make vegetable growers risk free.
 1. To fix protected price for the crops (Ladyfinger, Chilli, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Cabbage, Radish, Tomato, Onion, Potato, Cauliflower, Carrot, Peas, Capsicum, Brinjal, Turmeric, Garlic, Mango, Kinnow, Guava, Litchi, Plum)
 1. In case of selling of fruits/vegetables at lower prices in the market within the prescribed period, the difference in price upto the protected price will be compensated by the Government to the registered farmers.

Note: The incentive amount will be released into the Aadhar linked bank account of the farmer.

Application Process:
**Step 1:** Farmers should register themselves on the [Meri Fasal, Mera Byora Portal](https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period. It is mandatory for the farmer to avail the benefits under this scheme.
**Step 2:** On the homepage, click the link for &quot;Farmer Registration (Kisan Panjikaran).&quot;
**Step 3:** Go through the guidelines and click on &quot;Proceed for Registration.&quot;
**Step 4:** Complete the form by entering all the required details accurately.
**Step 5:** After verifying the entered details, click on &quot;Submit for Registration.&quot; Upon successful registration, the farmer will receive a username and password for portal access.
**Note 1:** Free registration of producer.
**Note 2:** Registration will be open only during the stipulated period.
**Note 3:** Registration facility will be available at Sarva Seva Kendra/e-Disha Kendra/ Marketing Board/Horticulture Department/ Agriculture Department and Internet Kiosk.
***Steps to Make Claims and Check Status:***

 - **Login to e-Kharid Portal:** Visit the [e-Kharid login](https://ekharid.in/Account/LogIn#no-back-button) page, enter your username, password, and the captcha code. - **Access the Dashboard:** Once logged in, farmers can make claims and track the status of their applications or complaints.
***J-Form - Sale Voucher:***
To receive compensation under the scheme:

 - Sale on J-Form will be mandatory for Incentive.
 - The &quot;J-Form,&quot; a sale voucher, must be obtained upon selling the produce.
 - After sale on J-Form, the sales details will be uploaded on BBY e-portal ([http://www.bby.hortharyana.gov.in/](http://www.bby.hortharyana.gov.in/)), for which facility will be available in the office of each concerned Market Committee. - Incentives will be payable on sale at J-Farm and the determined production per acre (whichever is less) as per the scheme guidelines.
 - Incentive will be payable by multiplying the difference in price.
 - The average daily wholesale price will be determined based on the daily prices of the Mandis identified by the Mandi Board as per the standards and guidelines of the scheme.

Brief Description:
The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology.

Detailed Description:
The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology. The scheme is implemented by Kerala Biotechnology Commission, KSCSTE to provide quick research support to young scientists to pursue their bright ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology. Proposals can be submitted in any branch of biotechnology related to medical, agriculture, veterinary, environment, marine, industrial or bio-resources. Post-doctoral students/Research Associates not having permanent positions can also be Principal Investigator provided a senior faculty/scientist holding permanent positions shall associate as Co-Principal Investigator. A maximum research grant of ₹30 lakh will be provided to the selected projects for a maximum duration of 3 years. Grants will be paid for specific projects to cover expenditure on manpower, equipment, consumables, contingencies and travel.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should possess a Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences.
2. The applicant should possess three years of post-doctoral experience in Biotechnology.
3. The applicant should be less than 40 years of age.
**Note:** Five years of relaxation in age would be available to scientists belonging to SC/ST/OBC, Women, and Physically Handicapped categories.

Benefits:
1. Young Scientists without fellowship/salary are eligible for a fellowship of ₹45,000/- plus 10% HRA per month, in addition to the support for travel, contingency, consumables, and minor equipment.
 1. A Principal Investigator having a regular position can seek manpower.
 1. Maximum support up to ₹30 lakhs (excluding overhead charges @ 10% of the project cost subject to a ceiling of ₹ 1.0 lakh) for a period not exceeding three years.

Application Process:
Applications are invited through advertisement or notification on the [website](https://kscste.kerala.gov.in/) of the Kerala Biotechnology Commission (KBC) and KSCSTE once a year. The Proposals can be submitted [online](https://submit.kscste.kerala.gov.in/) only on the notification and during the active time.
**Note 01:** Proposals under this programme shall be submitted online only. Proposals submitted in any other mode will not be considered and summarily rejected.
**Note 02:** The Principal Investigator shall also submit an Endorsement from the Implementing Institution, Certificate from the Investigators, Certificate of No pending SE&amp;UC, Resumes of PI and Co-I(s) and Self Appraisal of the PI to execute the project, etc. along with the project proposal (Document formats can be downloaded from the website).
**Selection procedure:**
**Stage 1:** **Submission and Evaluation of Pre – Proposal**
**Step 01: Submission of Pre-Proposal:** Once the call for proposal is notified, the PI has to initially submit the Preproposal for the proposed research fitting into the identified domain themes/sub-themes, as explained above, online.
**Step 02: Scrutiny of the Pre-proposal:** Upon receiving the pre-proposal, acknowledgement with a reference number will be issued to the PI through email and SMS. The project proposal will be scrutinized thereafter. Complete proposals with all the relevant documents will proceed further for Peer Review and the incomplete proposals will not be processed further and summarily rejected.
**Step 03:** **Peer Review of Pre-Proposal:** The pre-proposal will be forwarded to 3 subject experts for peer review. The preproposal will be evaluated based on an Evaluation Matrix containing 7 criteria (scores from 5 to 0), as per the following criteria: 
0: Fails to address the criteria cannot be evaluated.
1: Poor: The criterion is inadequately addressed and there are serious inherent weaknesses.
2: Fair: Broadly addresses the criterion, but there are serious inherent weaknesses.
3: Good: The proposal addresses the criterion well, but there are several shortcomings.
4: Very Good: The proposal addresses the criterion well, but a few shortcomings are found.
5: Excellent: The proposal addresses the criterion well, no shortcomings as such are found.
**Step 04: Screening Procedure after Scoring:** The reviewers will assign suitable scores based on the review of the pre-proposals. Based on review reports from reviewers, the proposals will be ranked based on the score points. Only 50% of the proposals that secure higher than 60% score points (average of scores by subject experts) will be considered to proceed to the next stage for submitting detailed proposals and others will be rejected. The PIs of the selected proposals will be intimated about the submission of detailed proposals.
**Stage 2: Submission and Evaluation of Detailed Proposal**
**Step 01:** **Submission of Detailed Proposal:** The PIs of the selected pre-proposals will be informed to submit the detailed Proposals online within the stipulated time frame.
**Step 02: Scrutiny and Peer Review:** The detailed Project Proposals will be scrutinized and sent to the referees for peer review. The proposal will be sent to five national-level experts in the concerned field for peer review. Based on the review reports from referees, the recommended proposals will be placed in the Programme Advisory Committee for YIPB (PAC-YIPB) for final decision.
**Step 03: Presentation before the Programme Advisory Committee (PAC):** The PI/Co-Is will be invited to present the proposal before the PAC. PAC is a high-level Committee comprising of National Level Experts and constituted by KBC. The Council assesses the objectives, scope, content and social relevance of the proposed project and recommends the nature and quantum of assistance to be provided to the approved project. The decision made by KBC based on the recommendations of PAC on such a proposal shall be final.
**Contact Details:**
The Scientist-in-charge
Kerala Biotechnology Commission
Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE),
Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram – 695 004
Telephone: (0471) 2548254, 2548406
E-mail: kbc.kscste@kerala.gov.in

Detailed Description:
This is an Internship Scheme by the Directorate of Women and Child Development, Government of Goa. The objective of this scheme is to offer aspiring postgraduate students an opportunity for internship facilities to be trained as qualified interns in state-run private children's and shelter homes who can be offered hands-on job training experience. The scheme is open to any student who has passed out from any of the recognised universities with a Master's Degree in Social Service/ Social Work/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Home Science/ Post Graduate Diploma in Counselling etc.

> **Number**

The total number of slots for interns per year shall be fixed at 15, extendable upto 20.

> **Duration**

> **Location**

The selected interns will have to undergo training and work at the following places:

1. State-Run Children's Home.
1. Protective Home for Women.
1. Juvenile Justice Boards.
1. Child Welfare Committees.

Brief Description:
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories for pursuing higher studies abroad in medical and post-graduation courses. It offers loans up to ₹15,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum to eligible students.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Foreign Study Loan" implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational and Economical Development Corporation (GUEEDC), Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories pursuing higher studies abroad. The scheme provides overseas study loans of up to ₹15,00,000/- for specific courses, including Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma), post-graduation diploma, and equivalent courses after Class 12th. To be eligible, the applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12 and belong to a family with an annual income of ₹6,00,000/- or less. The loan carries simple interest at the rate of 4% per annum with repayment terms varying based on the loan amount.

Eligibility:
- The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category.
- The applicant must be pursuing higher studies abroad.
- The applicant must be enrolled in Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, post-graduation courses (valid even if obtained after diploma), post-graduation diploma, or equivalent courses after Class 12th.
- The applicant must have scored 60% or more in Class 12th.
- The applicant must belong to a family with an annual income of ₹6,00,000/- or less.

Benefits:
**Loan Amount:** Up to ₹15,00,000/- for overseas study.
**Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum.
**Repayment Grace Period:** 1 year after completion of study before repayment begins.
**Flexible Repayment:** Borrower can repay the loan before the stipulated time limit.

**Repayment Schedule**

- For loans up to ₹5,00,000/-: Equal monthly installments over 5 years.
- For loans above ₹5,00,000/-: Equal monthly installments over 6 years.

Application Process:
**Step 1: Register on the Official Portal**

- Open the [official website](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in). Navigate to the “How to Apply” section and select “Foreign Study Loan.”- You will be redirected to the [e-SamajKalyan](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) Portal. On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on New User ‘[Please Register Here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/Registration.aspx)’. Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc. and then click on ‘Register’.- Log in using your credentials once registration is complete.

**Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form**

- After logging in, locate the application Form. Enter personal, academic, and family information in the respective modules: Name, gender, category, address, educational background, institution details, passport number, family income, occupation of guardians, and bank details (to be used for loan disbursement).
- Use dropdown selections in the "Patrata Column" (પાત્રતાની કોલમ) to correctly indicate your eligibility parameters. It is mandatory to select from the dropdown so that your application is processed under the right criteria.

**Step 3: Prepare and Upload Required Documents**

- Scan and upload clear, legible documents in the upload section. 
- Ensure each file is within the portal’s size and format limitations (usually PDF, JPEG or PNG) and named properly to avoid confusion during review.

**Step 4: Review and Final Submission**

- Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission.
- Save a local PDF copy of the completed form for your records. Click “Final Submit”.

**Step 5: Application Verification by GUEEDC**

- Upon submission, your application and uploaded documents will be reviewed by GUEEDC officials.
- You may be contacted via phone or email if: Any clarification is required, Additional documents are needed, or Corrections must be made.
- Maintain active communication channels and respond promptly to any such requests.

**Loan Sanction and Disbursement**

- If the application is accepted, a formal sanction letter will be issued.
- You may be asked to sign an agreement accepting the terms and repayment conditions of the loan.
- The sanctioned loan amount will be disbursed directly into your verified bank account.
- If any post-sanction verification or usage confirmation is required, comply as per instructions provided by GUEEDC.

Brief Description:
The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP) aims to honor scientists and technical experts for outstanding contributions and innovations in agriculture and allied sciences.

Detailed Description:
The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar under Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR),Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, recognizes and honors scientists and technical personnel who have made outstanding contributions in agriculture, agricultural education, extension, and allied sciences. This includes the development of new processes, products, tools, technologies, and innovative practices that enhance agricultural productivity and sustainability in India.
**Fields Covered:**
**The awards are categorized under three main streams, each covering the following four fields:**

1. Crops & Horticultural Sciences
1. Natural Resources Management & Agricultural Engineering
1. Animal & Fisheries Sciences
1. Social Sciences

**Award Categories & Number of Awardees:**

1. Innovation & Technology in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
1. Research in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees
1. Outstanding Interdisciplinary Team Research in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
1. Outstanding Woman Scientist in Agriculture, Agricultural Education, Extension & Allied Sciences – 1 awardee
1. Outstanding Young Scientist in Agriculture & Allied Sciences – 4 awardees

Eligibility:
**General Conditions:**

1. The applicant should be an Indian scientist working in agriculture or allied fields in ICAR institutes, public agricultural institutions, or Krishi Vigyan Kendras, and must have made significant contributions in India.
1. The applicant should have work (research, innovation, or extension) that shows clear and proven impact on society, economy, or environment, supported by the Head of the Institution.
1. The applicant can apply at any stage of their career, as no minimum service period is required.
1. The applicant should submit only one application for a particular contribution in a year, and the application will be valid only for that year.
1. The applicant should have a clean service record, with no pending enquiry or major punishment in the last five years.
1. The applicant should apply under only one category and cannot be considered for multiple categories.

**Category-wise Conditions:**

1. The applicant can apply individually or as part of a team (maximum five members) for innovation and research awards, and must be below 60 years of age.
1. The applicant applying for interdisciplinary research should be part of a team of at least three members from different disciplines, and the team leader must be below 60 years of age.
1. The applicant applying for the women scientist category should be a woman working in agriculture or allied fields, and must be below 60 years of age.
1. The applicant applying for the young scientist category should have a doctoral degree, hold a regular position, and must be below 45 years of age.

Benefits:
i. In the Award Ceremony, the Awardees shall be presented a Sanad (certificate) signed by the Hon'ble Union Minister (Agriculture & Farmers Welfare) & President, ICAR. A commemorative brochure, containing the citation and photograph of the awardees shall also be released on the day of the ceremony.
ii. The decoration to such persons who are not able to attend the award ceremony due to personal reasons (including indisposition, preoccupation, etc.) shall be deemed to have been conferred. No other person (including the spouse/next of kin) should be allowed to receive the award on behalf of the absentee awardee except in posthumous cases.

Application Process:
**Registration:**
**Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp)
**Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization.
**Step 3:** Fill in the required details:
Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number.
Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number.
**Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration.
**Apply:**
**Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials.
**Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click "[Nominate / Apply Now".](https://awards.gov.in/Home/AwardLibrary)
**Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form.
**Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.

The scheme “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry &amp; Dairying, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana belonging to the Scheduled Caste category can avail a subsidy for purchasing livestock. This subsidy will be provided after the establishment of the livestock units and can be availed as a loan by the beneficiary. The scheme covers the establishment of dairy units with 2 milch animals, 10+1 piggery units, and 15+1 sheep/goat units.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
 1. The applicant must be unemployed.
 1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
 1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
 1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

Benefits:
> **Financial Assistance under the Scheme:**

**Establishment of Dairy units of 2 milch animals:**

 - 50% subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2 milch animals;

**Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:**

 - 50% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
 - A maximum amount of ₹50,000/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.

**Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:**

**Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme:**

 - Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year, otherwise the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.

Application Process:

**Step 02:** Fill out the application form and attach all the relevant documents.
**Step 03:** Submit the completely filled application form and attached documents to the concerned official in the office.
**Step 04:** The Deputy Director of the concerned district will examine the applications on a first-come, first-served basis and process them accordingly.
The applicant may submit the application through Common Service Centres, Antodaya Kendra, Atal Sewa Kendra, e-disha Centres or any other such centre.

Brief Description:
The scheme “Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana” was launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote tourism and develop the industry by means of trained individuals.

Detailed Description:
The scheme “Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana” was launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote tourism and develop the industry by means of trained individuals. 
 With the increasing demand for skilled manpower in the field of Tourism and hospitality industry, it is imperative to encourage local youths to enroll in such courses. Therefore the Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh is pleased to sponsor students of the state for taking admission in different courses such as Hospitality and Catering, Food Production, Food &amp; Beverage Service, Front Office, Housekeeping, Bakery &amp; Confectionaries, etc. The need for trained professionals was felt for the growth of the Tourism industry in the state. Thus, this scheme was launched to support the training of individuals in the field of tourism.

Eligibility:
1. Any Arunachal Pradesh domicile can apply to avail of the benefit of this scheme.
 1. The candidate must have passed Class XII in any stream or equivalent for a B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration at the Institute of Hotel Management.
 1. The candidate must have passed Class X or XII in any stream or equivalent for Diploma Course in tourism or hospitality related subject i.e. Food Production, Food &amp; Beverage Service, Front Office, Housekeeping, Bakery &amp; Confectionaries.
 1. The candidate must be graduated in any stream for Post Graduate Diploma in tourism or hospitality related subject.
 1. The merit list will be drawn on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained under the criteria.
 1. The sponsorship is only for the student of the Scheduled Tribe of Arunachal Pradesh.

<br>

<br>

Benefits:
1. Sponsorship to study and take up courses in the field of tourism.
 1. The local youths may enroll in courses such as B.Sc. (Hospitality and Catering) and Diploma/PGD courses (Food Production, Food &amp; Beverage Service, Front Office, Housekeeping, Bakery &amp; Confectionaries).
 1. 8 students of the State will be sponsored to take up B. Sc. (H&amp;C) for 3 years degree course in a prestigious Institute recognized by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
 1. 25 students of the State will be sponsored to take up a Diploma course for one and half years in five demand-driven categories being offered by the Food Craft Institute, Nagaon, Assam which is affiliated with National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology.

Application Process:
**Step 01:** For taking benefit of this scheme, the applicant needs to visit the nearest District Tourism Office, Arunachal Pradesh.
**Step 02:** After the published advertisement, the interested candidates may submit their applications in plain paper or a prescribed format with relevant documents at the Directorate of Tourism, Arunachal Pradesh.
**Step 03:** After successful verification, the students will be selected as per the merit list drawn on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained under the criteria.
**Step 04:** Further, the applicant will be interviewed and assessed by the District administration (District Tourism Officer) before he/she receives the benefit.

Brief Description:
The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians belong to one of the following categories, to pursue Pre-Matric education: Tanners, Flayers, Waste Pickers and Persons who are either presently engaged in Manual Scavenging.

Detailed Description:
Launched in the year 1977-78, the scheme &quot;Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards&quot; is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians belong to one of the following categories, to pursue Pre-Matric education: Tanners, Flayers, Waste Pickers and Persons who are either presently engaged in Manual Scavenging.

Eligibility:
**Eligibility**
The scholarship will be admissible to the children/wards of Indian Nationals who, irrespective of their religion belong to one of the following categories:

1. Tanners & Flayers.
1. Waste Pickers.
1. Persons who are Manual Scavengers as defined under section 2(I) (g) of the Manual Scavengers Act 2013.
1. Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning as defined in Section 2(I) (d) of the Manual Scavengers Act 2013.

Other Conditions

1. The students may not be allowed to take up employment or render help to parents in their work during the course of their studies.
1. The award will be discontinued if a student fails to secure annual promotion except in case of unavoidable reasons to be certified by the Head of the Institution in which the student is studying.
1. If a student violates school discipline or any other terms and conditions of the scholarships, the scholarship may be suspended or even cancelled, subject to the satisfaction of the competent school authority. 
1. Migration of students from one institution to another would not normally be allowed during the course of the academic year except under exceptional circumstances and in the interest of the student's academic career.
1. The scholar obtaining benefits under this scheme is not allowed to avail of benefits under any other pre-matric scholarship scheme.
1. The students should be regular in attendance for which the yardstick is to be decided by the competent authority of the school.

Benefits:
**Rate of Scholarship**

1. Day Scholars: Class 1st to 10th: ₹ 110/- per month for ten months.
1. Hostellers: Class 3rd to 10th: ₹ 700/- per month for ten months.

**Ad-Hoc Grant**

1. ₹ 750/- per student per annum to all-day scholars.
1. ₹ 1000/- per student per annum to hostellers.

**Additional Provisions for Students with Disabilities**

1. Reader Allowance of ₹ 100 per month for blind students in classes III and X.
1. Transport Allowance of ₹ 50 per month for disabled students not residing in the hostel located within the premises of the educational institution.
1. Special Pay of ₹ 100 per month would be admissible to any employee of the hostel willing to extend help to a severely orthopedically handicapped student residing in a hostel managed by the educational institution or by the State Government/Union Territory Administration who may need the assistance of a helper.
1. Escort Allowance of ₹ 50 per month for severely handicapped day scholar students with lower extremity disability.
1. Extra Coaching Allowance of ₹ 100 per month to mentally retarded and mentally ill students in classes III and X.

**NOTE 1:** The students amongst target groups with disabilities covered under this scheme can, however, also get such additional benefits from other schemes, which are not covered in the above provision.
**Duration and Course of Studies**

1. The scholarships may be given to students enrolled in class 1st or any subsequent class or pre-matric stage in the case of day scholars.
1. The scholarships may be given to students enrolled in class 3rd or any subsequent class of the pre-matric stage in the case of hostellers.
1. The scholarship will terminate at the end of class 10th.
1. The duration of the scholarship in an academic year is ten months.

**Mode of Disbursal**

1. The scholarship amount will be payable from the date of joining to the date of leaving the school, excluding the period of vacation, which will be about 10 months in a year except in the cases where the student enters or leaves early in the midst of academic year. 
1. In order to ensure timely and correct payment of the scholarship amount to the beneficiaries, State Governments/UT administrations will ensure payment of scholarship through their accounts in banks through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) as prescribed by the Govt. of India. All State government/UT Administrations will implement a computerized management system of scholarships, including 'e-payment' system.

Application Process:
**Announcement of Scheme**
The scheme will be announced by the concerned State Government/Union Territory Administration well in time, by giving advertisements in the leading language newspapers local dailies and by using other suitable publicity media.
**Supply of Application Forms**
The concerned Department of the State Government/Union Territory administration will supply the application forms, which should be received back by that department along with the prescribed certificate, by the last date.
**Identification of Target Group**

1. The State Government/ UT Administration will define the modalities and issue instructions to concerned agencies for the identification of the target group.
1. The State Government will instruct the institutions to provide full support to students in submitting applications for scholarships.
1. The applications along with supporting documents should be called online along with hard copies.

**Submission of Application Forms**

1. The student should fill the application form and submit it to the School Authority.
1. The school should upload the applications in the portal.

**Renewal of Scholarship**
The scholarship, once awarded, may be renewed during the next academic year by the concerned State Government/Union Territory Administration.

Brief Description:
The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.

Detailed Description:
The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council. The research carried out independently in Kerala by young scientists of Indian origin with Ph.D. in any branch of Science and technology who have been working in Kerala for the last three years will be taken into consideration for the award.
 Candidates may be nominated by Vice-Chancellors of Universities in Kerala, Directors of R &amp; D Centres, Heads of Institutions &amp; departments and Fellows of Academies. Nominations will be valid for 3 years or the eligibility age whichever is earlier. Selection will be through a thorough review/evaluation by an expert committee.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Ph.D. holder with 3 years Post-Doctoral experience.
 1. The applicant should have working experience in any R&amp;D/Academic institution in Kerala continuously for the last 3 years.
 1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 37 years as on 31st December in the notifying year.

Benefits:
1. Each Awardee will be presented with a certificate and a cash prize of ₹50,000/-.
 1. The recipient may be considered by the Council for a research grant of ₹50 lakhs after due consideration of the research project with the help of an expert committee.
 1. The Awardee, within 3 years of the receipt of the award, will be considered for a visit abroad to present the research work at a conference.

Application Process:
> **Nomination Procedure:**

**Step 01:** Applications are invited through advertisement every year.
**Step 02:** Candidates may be nominated by Vice-Chancellors of Universities in Kerala, Directors of Research Institutes/ R &amp; D Centres of Industries, Heads of University Departments, Principals of Colleges with approved centers of research, Fellows of the Indian National Science Academy, Indian Academy of Sciences, National Academy of Sciences, India, Indian National Academy of Engineering and Indian Academy of Agricultural Sciences.
**Step 03:** Nominations will be valid for 3 years or the eligibility age whichever is earlier. However, a fresh nomination (only once) can be made, if the nominee has not yet crossed the age bar.
**Step 04:** Nominations in the prescribed format along with all supporting documents must reach the Director, KSCSTE, Sasthra Bhavan, Pattom P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 695004.
**Note:** Nominations that are not complete or received after the due date will not be considered.
> **Selection Procedure:**

**Step 01:** Candidates recommended by the screening committee after a rigorous criteria-based screening will be invited for the presentation of their research work.
**Step 02:** The candidates will be informed of their selection for the award individually by mail.
**Step 03:** The awards will be distributed during the inaugural session of the Kerala Science Congress by the Chief Minister. The Awardees have to make a presentation of the award-winning work in the Plenary Session of the Kerala Science Congress.

Brief Description:
The scheme aims to support institutions and individuals to organize tiatr-related cultural activities in Goa. It provides financial assistance for Konkani musical shows, competitions, and programs celebrating tiatr artists.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Promotion of Tiatr Related Activities" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support cultural institutions and individuals in organizing various activities related to tiatr in their respective villages and towns to preserve and promote the traditional Konkani theatrical art form. The scheme provides financial support for organizing Konkani musical shows, singing competitions, acting competitions, one act plays, and programs celebrating the contribution of local tiatr artists both deceased and living but non-active, while ensuring these activities are made accessible to the public free of charge. The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual willing to organize tiatr-related activities and must submit applications within specified advance notice periods ranging from 8 to 30 days depending on the activity type. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa and applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms available at the Tiatr Academy of Goa office.

Eligibility:
- The applicant must be a cultural institution or individual organizing tiatr-related activities in Goa.
- The applicant must organize activities in their respective villages or towns.
- The applicant must ensure the program is staged free of charge to the public.
- The applicant must agree to acknowledge Tiatr Academy of Goa collaboration in all promotional materials.
- The applicant must ensure content does not contain adverse remarks against governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion.

***For Konkani Musical Shows***

- The applicant must ensure lyrics are newly composed and not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums.
- The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments.
- The applicant must organize minimum 14 songs including interactive duets, duos, trios, quartets/quintets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.
- The applicant must submit typed lyrics and skit scripts at least 30 days in advance.

***For Singing Competitions***

- The applicant must ensure minimum 15 participants.
- The applicant must ensure participants sing newly composed kantaram not recorded on any Audio/Video/Digital Versatile Disc Albums.
- The applicant must arrange a band with minimum 5 instruments including drums, keyboard, guitar and 2 blowing instruments.
- The applicant must provide competition rules to Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- The applicant must submit typed song lyrics at least 8 days in advance.

***For Other Competitions***

- The applicant must submit application form at least 30 days in advance.

***For Celebrating Tiatr Artists***

- The applicant must focus on prominent tiatr artists such as actors, singers, writers.
- The applicant must submit application form at least 15 days in advance.

Benefits:
##### ***Financial Support Categories***

- ***Category A1*** ***- Konkani Musical Shows:*** Financial assistance for organizing shows with minimum 14 songs including duets, trios, quartets, choral songs, solos and at least 2 comedy skits.- ***Category A2*** ***- Singing Competitions:*** Financial assistance for organizing competitions with minimum 15 participants singing newly composed kantaram.- ***Category B1*** ***- Competitions:*** Financial assistance for acting competitions including monologue, dialogue, and one act play competitions.- ***Category B2*** ***- Celebrating Tiatr Artists:*** Financial assistance for organizing programs to remember and felicitate prominent tiatr artists.
##### ***Conditions***

- Programs must be staged free of charge to the public.
- All promotional materials must acknowledge collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- Backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo is mandatory.
- No adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or content against caste, creed, and religion permitted.
- Chief Guest and Guest of Honour must be decided in consultation with Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will be the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour.

Application Process:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - 
***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001***
_*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
_*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._

##### ***Application Deadline***
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents to Tiatr Academy of Goa office within the specified timeframe: 

- 30 days in advance for Musical Shows and Competitions.
- 15 days in advance for Celebrating Tiatr Artists.
- 8 days in advance for submission of song lyrics in Singing Competitions.

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:** **Coordinate with Tiatr Academy of Goa**

- After application acceptance, discuss and finalize the Chief Guest/Guest of Honour arrangements with Tiatr Academy of Goa, ensuring the President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will serve in this capacity.

**Step 2:** **Setup & Conduct the Event**

- Arrange for the mandatory backdrop of minimum size 6 feet x 10 feet displaying Tiatr Academy of Goa logo and collaboration statement. Ensure all promotional materials, advertisements, banners include the mandatory acknowledgment "This programme is organized in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa".
- Execute the approved tiatr-related activity ensuring compliance with all scheme norms including free admission to public, appropriate content guidelines, and proper collaboration acknowledgments throughout the program.

**Step 3:** **Financial Documentation & Payment Request**

- After the event, prepare a comprehensive statement of expenditure supported by original bills and stamped receipts for any expenses exceeding ₹5,000/- as required for payment processing.
- Submit the statement of expenditure along with all original bills and stamped receipts to Tiatr Academy of Goa for payment processing, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.

The scheme "Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship" was launched by the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Welfare Department, Government of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community.
- The applicant must have passed one of the following examinations - 

 (a) High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) examinations from the Board of Secondary Education (SEBA) or an equivalent educational board recognized by the Government of Assam during the current year.
 (b) The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate (HSSLC) examinations in any stream from the Assam Higher Secondary Education Council (AHSEC) or an equivalent educational board recognized by the Government of Assam during the current year.

Benefits:
The benefit is a one-time incentive of ₹10,000/- each.

**C. Saving Personal Information:** After filling in all necessary fields in this step, click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application.

**A. Uploading Required Files:** Under the "Upload Documents" tab, upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG).
**B. Document Formatting Check:** All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved.

Brief Description:
The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. The selected students receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjects.

Detailed Description:
The &quot;Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, with the objective of providing financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. In the first phase, six students will benefit annually from the scheme. Under this scheme, selected students will receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjects, including Sociology, Public Administration, Law, Economics, Political Science, and Anthropology.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks.
1. The applicant should be below 35 years of age at the time of application.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- from all sources.
1. Priority is given to candidates enrolled in central or state government universities in Rajasthan.
1. A maximum of two children from a single family (parents/guardians) can apply under the scheme.
1. The applicant should have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Rajasthan in one of the following subjects:

- Sociology
- Public Administration
- Law
- Economics
- Political Science
- Anthropology

***Other terms & conditions:***

 1. The selected candidate will have to submit a certificate regarding admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute in which he/she is pursuing Ph.D.
 1. Candidates selected for Ph.D. will have to submit certificate regarding attendance as prescribed by University Grants Commission (UGC).
 1. Every year a progress report of the research work done by the student will be submitted to the department and after completion of the research work a copy will be made available to the department also.
 1. In case the amount received as fellowship is misused by the student, the amount paid along with 10% interest will be recovered from the concerned student. The student will have to submit an undertaking to this effect on a non-judicial stamp of ₹100/-.

Benefits:
***Financial Assistance:***

- Selected Ph.D. candidates receive a monthly fellowship of ₹15,000 for up to three years.

***Mode of Disbursement:***

- The fellowship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account by cheque or DD.

**Duration*****:***

- The fellowship continues for a maximum duration of 3 years, subject to satisfactory academic progress.

Application Process:
**Step 1: Fill Out the Application Form**

- The applicant must fill out the prescribed application form released by the Rajasthan Government.
- Ensure that all personal, educational, and bank details are correctly entered.

**Step 2: Submit the Application**

Brief Description:
The objective of the One Tea Scheme is to ensure a minimum guaranteed price for fresh tea leaves to protect tea farmers from financial losses and provide economic stability. It also aims to support bought-leaf factories and promote sustainable tea cultivation in Meghalaya.

Detailed Description:
The One Tea Scheme, implemented by the Planning, Investment Promotion & Sustainable Development Department, Government of Meghalaya, is designed to support tea farmers in the state whose livelihoods have been affected by declining factory gate prices and shrinking cultivated areas. The initiative introduces a single-season price support mechanism that guarantees every registered grower a minimum price of ₹35 per kilogram of fresh tea leaves for conventional tea gardens and ₹40 per kilogram for organically certified tea gardens. By compensating the difference between the factory’s actual purchase price and the guaranteed minimum price, the scheme prevents farmers from being forced to sell their produce at a loss. 
This support helps ensure fair price realization, provides economic stability for farmers to reinvest in their plantations, and contributes to the preservation of ecological services and traditional knowledge associated with tea cultivation. In addition, the scheme offers a one-time financial benefit to bought-leaf factories to cover the gap between the price they pay for fresh green leaves from both small and large tea growers and the price at which they can profitably process and sell the manufactured tea.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be 18 years of age or above.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a tea farmer.
1. The applicant should possess a valid government-issued identity document.

Benefits:
1. Ensures fair and stable prices for tea farmers.
1. Prevents distress sales due to low factory rates.
1. Provides direct financial support via DBT.
1. Farmers receive ₹35/kg and ₹40/kg support price.
1. Government pays the difference if factory rate is <semi_colon ₹35/kg and <semi_colon ₹40/kg. 
1. Supports up to 10,000 kgs per farmer.
1. Encourages organic cultivation, using ₹40/kg as reference.
1. Targets 1,000 financially distressed tea farmers
1. Provide one time support to bought leaf factories

Detailed Description:
The “Saphalam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. The Transgender community faces severe problems such as discrimination and infringement of rights. It is the responsibility of the government to provide special privileges to such target groups, bringing them to the mainstream of society by ensuring social rehabilitation.
 Due to a lack of proper education and social stigma in society, the Transgender community is also subjected to severe unemployment. Thus, the Social Justice Department has rolled out this innovative scheme that provides financial assistance to Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma level professional courses. This scheme would provide an opening to Transgender students who possess high technical/professional competence.
 Those students who have qualified for such professional courses and suffer from financial constraints can continue their education uninterrupted which in turn would increase their employment opportunities and help them to secure a good job and thereby lead a quality life.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be Transgender.

 1. Transgender students who have secured admission in merit seats in Government, Aided/Self-financing colleges are eligible under this scheme.

 1. Transgender students pursuing Diploma level government-accredited courses are also eligible.
 1. Transgender students who have completed 18 years must submit a copy of their Transgender ID card.
 1. Those Transgender students who are below 18 years must submit a self-declaration statement duly certified by the Head of Institution/Parent.

Under the scheme, financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000/- per year will be provided to transgender students for pursuing professional courses at the degree/diploma level.

Brief Description:
The scheme aims to encourage the development of Tiatr by providing a platform for children aged up to 16 years to participate in traditional Konkani theatre productions. The scheme benefits Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, and Individual Producers.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Children's Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage the development of Tiatr by providing a platform for children aged up to 16 years to participate in traditional Konkani theatre productions, addressing the growing enthusiasm among students and individuals to involve children in Tiatr activities. The scheme provides financial support to participating groups and awards mementos and certificates across multiple categories including best performance, individual artistes, direction, technical aspects, and musical components. The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged 16 years or below on the application submission date and themes must be compulsorily based on the lives of children only. The scheme is implemented by Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted offline through prescribed application forms.

Eligibility:
- The applicant must be an Educational Institution, Sports and Cultural Association, or Individual Producer.
- The applicant must ensure all child performers are aged up to 16 years on the date fixed for submission of application.
- The applicant must ensure themes of Tiatr are compulsorily based on the lives of children only.
- The applicant must ensure the duration of the tiatr is not less than one hour and a half and not more than two hours and a half (including interval of minimum 10 minutes and maximum 15 minutes).
- The applicant must present the Tiatr in the traditional format as approved by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- The applicant must ensure the Tiatr has 6 to 7 acts (podd'dde) with at least 4 cantos.
- The applicant must ensure comedy is linked to the story of the play.
- The applicant must include at least 8 Kantaram which should include 1 duet (Interactive), 1 Duo (Interactive), 1 Trio (Interactive), 1 Quartet/Quintet (Interactive), 1 Choral Song and Solos.

> ***Priority***

- The first three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition will get a direct entry into this festival, provided their entries are received before due date.

> ***Other Conditions***

- Not more than 2 shows of the given script must have been performed prior to the performance at the competition.
- No adverse remarks against any Governments, Individuals, Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion in the scripts, lyrics of songs, performances, or speeches.
- Artistes including technicians and backstage artistes whose names appear in the submitted list shall be permitted to participate only under that troupe (Only musicians can take part in more than one troupe).

Benefits:
- Financial support as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- Financial assistance covers expenditure towards Music (Live Band with at least two blowing instruments), Light Effects, Stage Setting, Background Music, Make up, Costumes, Refreshments for rehearsals, and Transport.
- All payments made by cheques in the name of the Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, or Individual Producer.
- Free DVD copy of the recorded performance provided to the producer or director.
- Mementos and certificates awarded to winners in different categories (No Cash Prizes).
- Video recording of all tiatrs for preservation in Tiatr Academy of Goa Library.
- First three award winners of the previous year's Children Tiatr Competition get direct entry into the festival.

Application Process:
***(The scheme announcement will be made in the local press. Wait for this official announcement before proceeding with the application)***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to - 
***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001***
_*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
_*Applications are considered on a "First come First Serve" basis, subject to the availability of funds._
_*If any applicant withdraws after the schedule is drawn by Tiatr Academy of Goa, full security deposit will stand forfeited._
_*15 Educational Institutions, Sports and Cultural Associations, or Individual Producers will be given an opportunity to participate._
_*In case Tiatr Academy of Goa receives more than 15 applications, a meeting of all applicants will be called and the selection of remaining 12 troupes will be done by lots._
_*In case any of the 15 participants withdraws from the competition, the vacant place will be filled by the Troupe which is first on the waiting list._

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:****** ***Await Script Scrutiny Feedback***
After submission, Tiatr Academy of Goa will scrutinize the script to verify whether it is related to the lives of children and check the interactive nature of kantaram. Feedback, if any, will be provided to the applicant within 10 days. The Academy has the right to make suggestions for improvement or reject the script completely if found unrelated to children's lives.
**Step 2:****** ***Participate in Selection Process (If Applicable)***
If more than 15 applications are received, attend the meeting called by Tiatr Academy of Goa where selection of the remaining 12 troupes will be done by lots. The first three award winners of the previous year get direct entry if their applications are received before the due date.
**Step 3:****** ***Submit Final Documentation Before Competition***
Submit the final typed copy of the script, typed copy of songs (kantaram), cast of the tiatr, and summary of songs to Tiatr Academy of Goa during office hours exactly 3 days before the date of commencement of the tiatr competition.
**Step 4:****** ***Participate in Competition***
Stage the Tiatr at the place and day identified by Tiatr Academy of Goa according to the announced schedule. The performance will be judged by a panel of judges appointed by the Academy, and their decision will be final and binding on all participants.

Brief Description:
The policy aims to promote film production in Uttarakhand by providing financial grants to films, TV serials, and web series shot in the state, encouraging filmmakers to showcase Uttarakhand’s culture, heritage, and locations, and boosting local employment and the state's film economy.

Detailed Description:
The Uttarakhand film policy - 2024 “Grant to Films” is implemented by the Department of Information and Public Relations, Government of Uttarakhand. The policy aims to promote film production in Uttarakhand by providing financial grants to films, TV serials, and web series shot in the state, encouraging filmmakers to showcase Uttarakhand’s culture, heritage, and locations, and boosting local employment and the state&#39;s film economy.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a film producer.

Benefits:
Under the provisions of the Uttarakhand Film Policy–2024, grants are provided as follows:

 1. For films made in regional languages and dialects, a grant of 50% of the amount spent in the state or up to ₹2 crore, whichever is lower, will be provided.
 1. For films made in Hindi or in the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution, a grant of 30% of the amount spent in the state or up to ₹3 crore, whichever is lower, will be provided.
 1. For films made in foreign languages that have incurred an expenditure of at least ₹3 crore in the state, and in which the shooting locations of the state have been appropriately showcased, a grant will be provided of 50% of the amount spent in the state or up to ₹3 crore, whichever is lower.
 1. For TV serials or web series produced in Hindi or in the languages listed in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution, as well as in the regional dialects of Uttarakhand, a grant will be provided of either 30% of the amount spent in Uttarakhand during the shooting period or up to ₹3 crore, whichever is lower.

Application Process:
After obtaining the Film Censor Certificate and the release/exhibition of the film, the film producer applies for the grant. For this, the producer must submit all expenditure details, contracts, invoices, and other related documents concerning the film production to the department.
The technical and financial committees constituted for granting film subsidies examine the film proposals and review the films before considering the grant. Based on the recommendation of the financial committee, the grant amount is approved and sanctioned by the Hon’ble Chief Minister/Chairman of the Film Development Council. (Applications for the grant must be submitted offline to the Film Development Council, Information and Public Relations Department, Dehradun.)

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage non-commercial dramatic troupes participating in Kala Academy’s yearly Tiatr Festival to produce Tiatrs of better quality. The scheme provides financial support for specific aspects of drama, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport. It also features the video recording of the Tiatr for the Tiatr Academy of Goa Library, with a free Digital Versatile Disc copy provided to the institution, and offers expertise through compulsory workshops in various Tiatr components.

Eligibility:
- The applicant must be a dramatic troupe.
- The applicant must be participating in the Tiatr Competitions organized by Kala Academy.
- The applicant must fulfill the conditions laid down in the scheme as per the format enclosed.
- The applicant's Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee who will submit a report on whether the Tiatr is as per the format.

- The applicant's Tiatr, in any form either written or verbal, must not contain any adverse remarks against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
- The applicant must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe.

Benefits:
##### ***1. Financial Support***

- For improving aspects of Tiatr production, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport. 
- The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- Direct payment to the Institution based on submitted bills.

***Conditions***
_*The troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of its members; otherwise, they will not be entitled to avail the benefits of this scheme._
_*The Tiatr must not contain any adverse remark in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments; if proved so, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made._ 
_*All advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners/standees, etc., must insert/publish and announce before the performance and during the interval that ‘This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’._ 

##### ***2. Video Recording of Tiatr and Digital Versatile Disc Copy***

- Tiatr Academy of Goa will video record the said Tiatr for its Library and other uses. One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc will be given to the Institution free of cost. To preserve the presentation of Tiatr for future generations. 
- The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any manner, but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc.

*The videographer will be appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.

##### ***3. Expertise and Workshops***
Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide expertise to the troupes in the different compartments of Tiatr (Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, Transport) by organizing workshops in those aspects.
***Conditions***
_*The troupe will have to compulsorily participate in these workshops by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe._

Application Process:
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should take a printout of the [prescribed format](https://www.goa.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Citizen-Charter-TAG.pdf) of the application form.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date.
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to - 
***Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001***
_*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment._
*The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.

##### ***Post-Application Processes***
**Step 1:** ***Await Script Scrutiny***
Upon submission, the Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee to determine if it aligns with the prescribed format. The Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and recall or refrain from payment if any adverse remarks against Government/Individual/Institution, caste, creed, or religion are found.
**Step 2:** ***Participate in Workshops***
The applicant troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one member to receive benefits. Failure to participate will result in ineligibility for the scheme's benefits.
**Step 3:** ***Ensure Proper Public Announcement and Promotion***
The applicant must ensure that all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, banners, or standees, prominently include the statement: ‘This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’. This announcement must also be made before the performance and during the interval.
**Step 4:** ***Submit Financial Documents for Disbursement***
To receive financial assistance, the institution must submit original bills along with a statement of expenditure to the Tiatr Academy of Goa. Payments will be made directly to the Institution for services rendered, and service providers must provide receipts, with stamped receipts mandatory for amounts exceeding ₹5,000/-.

The “Jharkhand Sportsperson Pension Scheme” was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Affairs, Government of Jharkhand. aims to provide financial support to retired athletes for their lifelong contribution to sports. Athletes, including Arjuna, Dronacharya, and Dhyan Chand awardees, Olympic participants, and Commonwealth or Asian Games medalists, receive a monthly pension.

Brief Description:
The scheme aims to award financial scholarships to eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, specifically to foster their development and prepare them for future entry into the officer’s cadre of the Armed Forces. Benefits include coverage for School Fee, etc.

Detailed Description:
The scheme "Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram" was launched by the School Education Department, Government of Mizoram. The scheme aims to award scholarships to all eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who qualify and are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip. The objective of establishing the school is to facilitate the all-round development of a child’s personality and remove regional imbalance in entry into the officer’s cadre of the Armed Forces via the National Defence Academy. The scheme provides financial assistance covering School Fee, Dietary Charge, and Clothing Money, with the quantum of benefits depending entirely upon the income level of the parent or guardian.

Eligibility:
- The applicant should belong to Mizoram State only.
- The applicant must qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society.
- The applicant must be admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram.
- The applicant must not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme.
- The applicant must submit Income certificates/salary certificates at the time of admission for the grant of scholarship.
- For Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST): The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹1,00,000/- (One lakh) per month.
- For General Category: The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) per month.
- The applicant must not be more than one child of the same parents’/guardians eligible for the said scheme.

_*The scholarship will be discontinued if the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the National Defence Academy._
_*The scholarship will be cancelled and the amount recovered if the student is found to have obtained the scholarship by false statements, and the student will be blacklisted forever._
_*The student is liable to refund the scholarship amount if they discontinue the studies for which the scholarship was awarded during the course of the year._

Benefits:
***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year)
***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Up to ₹50,000/- OR General Category: Up to ₹25,000/-
***Benefit Rate:*** Rate I (Full)
***State Government's Share:*** 100% of Fee/Charge + ₹2,000/- (For Fee only)
***Central Share:*** NIL

***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year)
***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: ₹50,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- OR General Category: ₹25,000/- to ₹50,000/-
***Benefit Rate:*** Rate II (50%)
***State Government's Share:*** 50% of Fee/Charge + ₹1,000/- (For Fee only)
***Central Share:*** 50%

***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year)
Parent Income Category (per month): Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Above ₹1,00,000/- OR ***General Category:*** Above ₹50,000/-
***Benefit Rate:*** Rate III (None)
***State Government's Share:*** NIL
***Central Share:*** 100%

- The scholarships cover approved compulsory fees payable to the Institution, with the State’s share disbursed to the Institution by the awarding authority, the Mizoram Scholarship Board.

- The State’s share of the scholarship is disbursed to the Institution (Sainik School Chhingchhip).
- The scholarship is available for only one year for studying in any class but is renewable as per Rules/Condition. For renewal, the scholarship is paid following the month up to which the same was paid in the previous year.
- Cadets are expected to use the sanctioned scholarship amounts to purchase necessary textbooks, stationery, and related items.

***Conditions***

- The award is tenable from the stage it is given until the completion of the course.
- Continuation is subject to the student demonstrating satisfactory progress, maintaining good conduct, and ensuring regularity in attendance.
- The award will be discontinued if the student fails to secure annual promotion, unless unavoidable reasons are certified by the competent authority of the scheme.
- If a student repeats a class, they will not receive a scholarship for that specific class for the second or subsequent year.
- If a cadet is declared medically unfit by the appropriate medical authority for entry into the National Defence Academy, the scholarship awarded shall be discontinued from the date the cadet is declared unfit.
- The value of the scholarship may be reduced at the sanctioning authority's discretion if the Principal reports that any scholar is without textbooks or stationery.
- The scholarship may be cancelled, stopped, or further payments withheld if the student makes unsatisfactory progress or is guilty of misconduct, such as resorting to or participating in strikes or irregular attendance.

Application Process:
**Step 1:** ***Qualifying the Entrance Examination and Securing Admission***

- The applicant must first appear for and successfully qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society to become eligible for consideration.
- Following qualification, the applicant must secure admission to Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram, as the scholarship is specifically available only for studies in this institution.

**Step 2:** ***Submission of Financial Documentation at Admission***

- At the time of formal admission to the Sainik School, the parent or guardian of the eligible student must submit the necessary financial documentation to the concerned Institution for the grant of scholarship. 
- This mandatory submission includes providing valid Income certificates and/or Salary certificates to determine the applicable scholarship rate (Rate I, II, or III) based on the financial criteria for the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or General Category.

**Step 3:** ***Institutional Submission to the Awarding Authority***

- After the Institution finalizes the selected and admitted lists, it shall compile and forward the list of eligible cadets to the Nodal Department.
- The scheme's administrative authority is the Mizoram Scholarship Board, which serves as the Nodal Department responsible for administration and implementation.

> ***Scholarship Disbursal and Reimbursement***

- The Mizoram Scholarship Board, acting as the awarding authority, will disburse the State’s share of the approved scholarship amount directly to the Institution.
- This payment method ensures that the Institution is reimbursed for all the approved compulsory fees that the cadet is liable to pay.

Detailed Description:
The scheme &quot;Financial Assistance to WW II Veterans and Widows of WW II Veterans&quot; is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹10,000/- per month shall be given to Ex-servicemen of the Pre-Independence Era (World War-II Veterans) i.e. Ex-servicemen enrolled before 31st August 1945 &amp; their widows, who are not in receipt of any kind of pension/financial assistance or maintenance allowance either from any Department of Government of India/State Government or from any Body/Organization controlled by Central/State Government. Only bonafide residents of Haryana State are eligible for grant of financial assistance and the applicants shall have to produce a domicile certificate issued by the competent authority as authorized by the Haryana Government and an attested copy of the Ration Card.

Eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
 1. The applicant should be an ex-serviceman of the Pre-Independence Era (World War II Veterans) i.e. ex-servicemen enrolled before 31st August 1945 &amp; their widows.
 1. Only World War II Veterans of other ranks (i.e., Havildar and below) who are in penury and have an annual income from all sources below ₹2,00,000/- are eligible under the scheme.
 1. The applicant should not be in receipt of any kind of pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from any department of the Government of India/State Government or from anybody/organization controlled by the Central/State Government.
 1. World War II Veterans and their widows, who have income from any job/profession/business, are not entitled to a grant of financial assistance.
